name: TradeCore ERP
description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-18 SYSTEM-WIDE INVINCIBLE-SCOPE FIX: company_id degraded to NaN and the whole workspace silently re-scoped to an invalid company — 'Company Parent: N/A' everywhere, inactive-company GUI freeze, and every auto-sync (boot snapshot, switch, cross-device poll, v2 list fallback) REPLACED local categories/stock/branches with empty or global payloads. Root cause: server mints STRING UUID ids (co_<hex>/crypto.randomUUID) but the frontend treated them as numbers — `Number(localStorage. active_company_id)` and `Number(<select>.value)` produced NaN, and strict === between string UUID and number broke every parent-name/category/company filter. Fixes: (1) string-ID discipline — currentCompanyId/currentBranchId/currentStoreId are now string|null, new src/utils/idUtils.ts (sv/sameId/isValidCompanyScope/isRealCompanyId/safeCompanyId), boot reconcile/context-change/settings-select/impersonate/poll/switch-effect all use sameId + reject invalid targets (a NaN target can no longer trigger a destructive snapshot); (2) category scope — normalizedPersistence parses 'co_<id>:<name>' prefix as a STRING (was parseInt -> NaN) and Category.companyId is string; categoryHelper formatCompanyCategory/getCompanyCategories are string-safe; (3) company_id injection — newly created customers/suppliers now carry company_id, and after deleting a company the cascade is server-side in ONE transaction (v2_delete_company soft-deletes companies/stores/stock_categories/products/user_accounts, legacy tradecore_users/products/sales/marketplace_orders, hard-deletes audit_trails, strips blob arrays, bumps version, rollback on failure) so the next snapshot can no longer REBUILD the deleted company; (4) server-side scope gate — tcValidCompanyScope() + degenerate-scope guards in snapshot/get_state and every v2_* action reject 'NaN'/'undefined'/'null'/'all' scopes with empty/refusal payloads (never the global blob fallback). Acceptance: deploy head commit -> hard refresh -> company selector shows a real company (no NaN) -> Company Parent resolves -> add product/category -> cross-device sync no longer wipes local data -> delete a company -> SELECT * FROM companies/stores/stock_categories WHERE id/company_id=<id> shows deleted_at set (purge clears them). Table is 'companies'.
